components.name: Validation Button
components.description: Primary action for issuing or retrying an evaluation ticket.

components.name: Risk Action
components.description: Full-width action attached to the carbon-copy risk receipt.
components.css: .ds-btn-risk { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 22px; color: #fffdf7; background: #39256f; font: 800 13px/1.2 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; clip-path: polygon(8px 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,100% 8px,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,8px 100%,0 calc(100% - 8px),0 8px); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-risk:hover { background: #26174f; } .ds-btn-risk:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(189,45,55,.35); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-risk:active { filter: brightness(.92); }

components.name: Ticket Input
components.description: Ruled, borderless field for symbols and quantitative inputs.

components.css: .ds-verdict { position: relative; min-width: 300px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(13,27,61,.52); color: #111a2d; background: #f7f4ed; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -34px rgba(5,15,38,.9); clip-path: polygon(12px 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 12px,100% calc(100% - 12px),calc(100% - 12px) 100%,12px 100%,0 calc(100% - 12px),0 12px); } .ds-verdict-label { display: block; color: #647087; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-verdict strong { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: #8f1f29; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-verdict-stamp { position: absolute; right: 28px; bottom: 30px; padding: 9px 13px 8px; border: 3px double #bd2d37; color: #bd2d37; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .12em; transform: rotate(-7deg); } .ds-verdict:hover { border-color: rgba(13,27,61,.7); } .ds-verdict:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(189,45,55,.35); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Risk Receipt
components.description: Carbon-copy paper reserved for stop, risk, and position output.
components.css: .ds-receipt { min-width: 260px; padding: 24px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(57,37,111,.62); color: #39256f; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-3deg,transparent 0 6px,rgba(57,37,111,.055) 6px 7px),#d8c9e8; font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; clip-path: polygon(12px 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 12px,100% calc(100% - 12px),calc(100% - 12px) 100%,12px 100%,0 calc(100% - 12px),0 12px); } .ds-receipt span { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; opacity: .74; } .ds-receipt strong { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font: 850 52px/.95 "DIN Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-receipt b { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-receipt hr { margin: 19px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(57,37,111,.45); } .ds-receipt:hover { border-color: #39256f; } .ds-receipt:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(189,45,55,.35); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Validation Stamp
components.description: Explicit pending, void, or valid mark that re-stamps the verdict.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; max-width: 140px; padding: 9px 13px 8px; border: 3px double currentColor; color: #bd2d37; font: 900 12px/1.25 "Avenir Next", Avenir, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-7deg); } .ds-stamp:hover { filter: saturate(1.15); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(189,45,55,.35); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stamp:active { transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(.98); } .ds-stamp-valid { color: #246d59; transform: rotate(-4deg); }

components.name: Confirmation Row
components.description: Ruled user-confirmation choice with visible consequence copy.
components.css: .ds-option { display: grid; min-height: 42px; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr; gap: 9px; align-items: start; padding: 8px 9px; border: 1px solid #bd2d37; color: #111a2d; background: rgba(189,45,55,.07); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option input { width: 15px; height: 15px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: #bd2d37; } .ds-option strong { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-option small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #647087; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: #8f1f29; } .ds-option:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid rgba(189,45,55,.35); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Glacier Signal turns a stock evaluation into an issued trading document: carrier navy holds the set, paper-white coupons carry the verdict, and a carbon-purple receipt records risk and position outputs. The mood is procedural, restrained, and accountable. Every result should feel stamped, attached, and auditable rather than summarized in a generic analytics dashboard.

The system favors dense but ordered information, visible provenance, and state changes that leave a legible trace. Paper grain, ruled lines, perforations, clipped corners, carbon numerals, and validation marks provide character without weakening Chinese body-text clarity. Red marks action, failure, pending issuance, and cancellation; green is reserved for completed validation.
keyCharacteristics: Ticket-book composition held by deep carrier navy
Warm paper coupons and a distinct carbon-copy risk surface
Clipped corners, dashed tears, perforation holes, and ruled rows
Condensed, tabular numerals for scores, prices, and codes
Explicit pass, fail, and pending words or symbols alongside color
Verdict-first hierarchy with risk output visibly attached

rules.name: The Carbon Boundary Rule
rules.body: Carbon purple belongs to risk, stop, position, and their attached action; do not spread it across ordinary content.

rules.name: The Ink Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red, green, and amber are operational states, not decorative accents, and color never stands alone.

rules.name: The Numerical Authority Rule
rules.body: Prices, scores, dates, codes, shares, and percentages use tabular numerals; the largest type is reserved for the one value that decides the current step.

rules.name: The Attached Sequence Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes may reorder and compress coupons, but they must preserve the task sequence and the visual sense that checks, verdict, and risk receipt belong to one issued set.

rules.name: The Printed-First Rule
rules.body: Texture, borders, and overlapping stock establish depth before shadow; never turn coupons into glossy floating cards.

rules.name: The Cut, Do Not Round Rule
rules.body: Use clipped corners for tickets, buttons, headers, and coupons; reserve true circles for compact status or selection marks.

dos: Do lead with the current verdict and any blocking condition before score detail.
Do preserve the carrier, coupon, carbon-copy, perforation, and validation-mark vocabulary across screen sizes.
Do pair red, green, and amber with text or a distinct symbol.
Do keep quantitative values tabular and keep risk output on carbon purple.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and maintain visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't reinterpret the evaluation as a grid of interchangeable rounded metric cards.
Don't use purple as a general accent outside the risk receipt and its quantitative links.
Don't let a score visually erase a failed, void, or pending condition.
Don't detach the backtest action from the risk receipt.
Don't compress mobile into a horizontal rail or allow horizontal scrolling.
